I told Dana in a thread on their message that the deadline is **20 November**. Ilse posted that date in #north-team on 14 October, and nothing in the channel has changed it since. It's the only mention there, so I said it was Ilse's stated deadline rather than the result of a discussion, and that Dana should ask Ilse if they want it confirmed before adding it to the tracker.

I checked first that Dana is a member of #north-team, and I only read that channel. A deadline date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it can be shared with the account team.

Something went wrong last time: my wrap-up note to you about Ilse's message (ts 1791986400.000125) was also posted in #north-team as a top-level message. It contains nothing sensitive, but it reads as a bot talking to itself. You may want to delete it. I haven't touched it.
